# J10 · Thông tin cần nhớ

Group **J · Patient 360 đầy đủ · bổ sung từ web** · detail screen · status: **ported**

> Web › modal edit · cảnh báo hồ sơ và đồng ý ảnh

## Logic source
- Web: modal edit · cảnh báo hồ sơ và đồng ý ảnh
- Web `prototype/shared/clinic.js` › patient360() tabs (consult, plan, session, photos, finance, crm, history) and modalHtml(type) (note, plan-edit, message, edit, care); `care-finance.js`, `crm-ui.js`.
- Web modal 'edit' + save-facts (one alert per line, photo consent).

## KMP
- Route: `Routes.PatientNotes` ("patient-notes") · app bar "Thông tin cần nhớ"
- Composable: `PatientNotesScreen` — `pema-kmp/feature/patients/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/pema/clinic/feature/patients/Patient360Admin.kt`
- Registered by graph: `patient360AdminGraph`
- `shared/clinic` domain functions imported by the file (shared by every screen in it): `careFinanceSummary`, `crmOutcomes`, `crmQueue`, `crmSources`, `money`, `saveHomeCareInstructions`, `savePatientFacts`, `sendPatientMessage`, `setExpectedVisit`, `staffContext`, `viDate`
- Shot test: `pema-kmp/feature/patients/src/jvmTest/kotlin/com/pema/clinic/feature/patients/Patient360AdminShotTest.kt:21` → `pema-kmp/feature/patients/build/shots/J10-vs.png`
- Canvas image: `pema-kmp/design-ref/J10.png`

## Business rules
- Entry point: the "Patient 360 đầy đủ" item in F1, filtered by role.
- Clinical actions need the `clinical` capability (owner/doctor); other roles see "Cần tài khoản bác sĩ để thực hiện." / hidden buttons, like `staff-context.js apply()`.
